We'll buy it as‑is. You don't fix a thing.

No repairs, no cleaning, no showings, no agent commission and no fee of any kind. Tell us about the property, and in most cases you'll have an offer within 24 hours. You're free to say no.

No repairs

We buy houses as‑is. You don't need to do any repairs, or even clear the property out.

No cost to you

Nothing. We don't charge fees to discuss your situation, make you an offer, or buy your home. There's never a commission when we buy directly.

No obligation

Filling in the form commits you to nothing. We review, we make an offer, and you accept or reject it. Entirely your choice.

Completely confidential

Your privacy matters to us. Anything you tell us stays between us — no signs in the yard, no listing, no neighbours knowing.

What we buy

Any condition. Any area. Any situation.

We buy houses in any condition, in any area, in any price range, in any situation. If you're wondering whether your particular problem is too complicated — it almost certainly isn't. We are a professional real estate solutions company with years of experience in exactly these situations.

  • In foreclosure, behind on payments, or in bankruptcy
  • Over‑leveraged, or worth less than what's owed
  • Liens, code violations or health department notices
  • Condemned, fire damaged, or structurally failing
  • Inherited, vacant, or full of belongings you don't want to deal with
  • Tenanted, problem tenants, or mid‑eviction
  • Simply not maintained, and you don't want to start now

If you're behind on payments or facing foreclosure, contact us for a confidential consultation. There are usually more options than people realize, and the earlier the conversation happens the more of them are still open.

How it works

Four steps, and most of them are ours.

01

You send the property details

Complete the form below. One of our real estate solutions specialists will contact you shortly — usually within 24 hours.

02

We research the property

In some situations we'll need to gather a little more information. We'll research the property and discuss all the details with you.

03

You get an offer

We may be able to make an offer right over the phone. In most cases we'll schedule a time to view the property first, then make you an offer.

04

You decide

Accept and we close on your timeline. Reject and that's the end of it — no pressure and no follow‑up campaign.

Are you REALTORS™? No. Red Rugger LLC is a real estate investment and solutions company — property acquisition specialists who buy houses directly from sellers. We want to buy your home. That said, if listing your property is genuinely the better outcome for you, we'll tell you so and connect you with a recommended licensed agent.
